title: ACF logical coaching contract catalog

x-contract-metadata.schema_scope: Documentary logical contracts for the four owned foundations; JSON Schema verifies representation only. Cross-record and sporting invariants below require separate checks and competent review.
x-contract-metadata.reference_resolution: Ref binds immutable id/revision/hash. Exact consumed approvals also require current registry/revocation lookup at decision and effect; an immutable hash alone never proves current authority.
x-contract-metadata.mec_warning: Existing AEOS conceptual 0..6, not a new action enum and not a strict blind order. CL0..CL5 is not introduced. Compare whole-horizon effects and relevant smaller alternatives. Autonomy A..E is a different axis.
x-contract-metadata.current_runtime_authority: NONE; all levels are proposed future ceilings and fixtures only.

x-invariants.requirement: All critical refs resolve to one subject, allowed purpose and exact revision/hash; cross-account or suppressed source is rejected before sporting interpretation.
Zero is only KnownValue(value=0). Unknown sensor, source lag or refusal cannot be substituted with zero, no training, normal recovery or failed adherence.
x-invariants.failure_behavior: retain UNKNOWN; C only if answer changes supported choice

x-invariants.requirement: Deduplicate canonical origin fact plus active revision and exposure segment, not delivery ID. Two separately confirmed real sessions remain distinct. Corrections replace affected contribution; old deliveries cannot resurrect suppressed/superseded facts.

Observed known past segment once + unknown past remainder + separately planned future remainder. Never add a planned matched past segment to actual exposure, or sum local projections as independent systemic sessions.

Executed target map binds each completed prefix to immutable executing target. Accepted successor applies only to future suffix. Deliberate withdrawal is not original-target failure or original-stimulus achievement.

Comparison requires dimension/method/unit/load convention/configuration/target baseline compatibility. No pace inversion error, per-hand-total conversion by guess, machine-stack equivalence, RIR-to-session-RPE collapse or km-to-sets conversion.

Exact/banded semantic conformity is only to explicitly accepted target. Physiological intent, tolerance and essential stimulus need recipe-specific approved comparator; no universal adherence percent. Critical unknown means overall adherence UNCLASSIFIED.
x-invariants.failure_behavior: retain known dimensions; no physiological inference

x-invariants.requirement: Unknown eligibility routes C/ELIGIBILITY_UNASSESSED; clinical dependency routes E/HOLD; unsupported prescription/approval routes D. One cannot be silently substituted for another.
Initial plan has base NONE, REPLAN scope INITIAL, APPLY_PLAN_CHANGE, adequacy NOT_APPLICABLE_INITIAL and exact adoption B. Existing adopted sessions require a different horizon/base path.
x-invariants.failure_behavior: reject fake initial or implicit adoption

x-invariants.requirement: Current valid ADEQUATE plan ends at KEEP/learn-only with no delta, plan revision, export or adaptation notice. Discretionary theoretical improvement does not create necessity.

Existing-plan mutation requires INADEQUATE and necessity REQUIRED, or immediate restriction authority control. Each material candidate records KEEP and relevant smaller alternatives with concrete insufficiency reasons.

No new progression action enum: a positive dose change is represented by complete supported REPLAN or other existing applicable action with reason PROGRESSION, not by misusing REDUCE_VOLUME. Already prescribed progression is ordinary accepted execution.

BALANCED_HYBRID has both co-primary goals. Opposed goal effects are INCOMPARABLE unless an explicit accepted trade-off resolves them. No weights, hidden runner-first or ID tie-break for material trade-off.
Only equivalent no-material-loss options can be stabilized/tied by canonical ID. Schedule preference and essential stimulus conflicts are handled by partial B0 comparator.
Placement wholly fits actual window with equipment, setup/travel where supplied, no overlap and double preference. A free window never implies demand tolerance or permission for doubles.

Interaction compatibility is approved for the joint prescription/configuration/context, not a universal time gap. NO_SUPPORTED_RECIPE, INTERACTION_UNASSESSED and SEARCH_INCOMPLETE cannot be labelled proven SCHEDULE_UNSAT.

An envelope is a joint admissible set with dimensional units, essential-stimulus and coupling predicates. Individual legal bounds do not imply legal combinations. Range bounds require min<=max; finite branches must be complete.

A is possible only for permitted no-op/model use or an exact complete preaccepted execution branch with current guards. Broad range acceptance never grants silent chosen-plan/suffix mutation. New mutation remains B or D.

Every material prescription has exact reviewed hash, population/applicability and satisfied conditions with CURRENT nonrevoked approval. LIMITED_REVERSIBLE_RECOMMENDATION/ABSTAIN/REVISE/PENDING are not prescriptive approval.

At least all eight sufficiency criteria appear once for each LearningHypothesis. SUPPORTED_FOR_BOUNDED_USE requires applicable rule and required predicates SATISFIED or justified NOT_APPLICABLE, distinct repeated episodes, no decisive unresolved contradiction and permitted purpose.

One event, repeated transports, correlated sensors or copied summary cannot become stable pattern or causal proof. A single contradiction can increase uncertainty; a material applicability/safety change suspends use immediately without waiting for hysteresis.

Secondary longitudinal purpose is OFF by default. Using its hypotheses requires ON plus independent legal/privacy gates; revocation stops dependent queue/use and removes or ceases derivatives. Primary value cannot depend on opt-in.

Synthetic fixture episodes and pattern changes are data_class SYNTHETIC end to end; never count as actual observations, calibrated confidence, efficacy, human validation or empirically proven sufficiency.

Recovery state, session readiness, adequacy/necessity and plan decision are separately versioned. No recovery/readiness output writes a delta or releases a hold. No sensor score alone selects prescription.
A local recovery inference requires named region/task and applicable attribution+interpretation rule. Otherwise preserve local report/exposure and omit unsupported recovery claim.

Tier A/B/C denotes available evidence, not confidence or safety. Tier C can sustain an approved no-wearable path; tier A may still have critical unknowns. No proprietary score/HRV isolated change creates clearance.

ASK has supported branch consequences, includes unknown/declined, minimizes information and distinguishes athlete fact/preference from domain authority. If all supported branches are unchanged, do not ask gratuitously.

SESSION_STARTED invalidates the whole pending compound proposal involving that session. Prestart reasons cannot be relabelled as new fact or new hash to reoffer its suffix. New post-start material fact can support a successor under all guards.

Confirmation binds hash/scope/base/context/goals/permission/restriction-hold epoch/policy-approval/capability/execution revisions. Revalidate before each commit/dispatch. New hold/revoked approval wins. Old absence of hold does not authorize later effect.
x-invariants.failure_behavior: STALE or REVOKED; zero new effect

x-invariants.requirement: One logical intent applies once. Duplicate acceptance/retry produces no new plan revision or exposure. Atomic guard/current-state comparison or equivalent control required; external exactly-once is never asserted.
x-invariants.failure_behavior: idempotent existing result or explicit stale

x-invariants.requirement: Late corrections update dependent future projections/decisions without rewriting what was known/prescribed/executed historically. Retain minimal allowed suppression precedence; no unbounded raw-health retention.

JEV is SHADOW; model failure/disagreement leaves deterministic official result identical for identical relevant inputs. LLM cannot generate dose, choose permission, change goal, clear hold, resolve source conflict or perform effect.
No production operation is authorized by this artifact, schema validation or documentary scenario. Runtime effects require separate explicit mission and all competent current gates.

A clinical restriction or new actual safety dependency is processed immediately, without waiting for hysteresis, future block boundary or confirmation to suspend system recommendation. User remains able to record actual behavior and exercise rights.

No timestamps, sets, percentages, observation counts, recovery gaps, dose increments or validity durations are physiological defaults supplied by this schema. Such numbers are exact fixture facts or reviewed recipe/rule parameters only.
Proposed envelopes may carry no accepted plan/agency refs; after exact valid adoption create a bound ACCEPTED revision. A proposed envelope and its branches never confer execution authority.

x-event-order: Occurred-at and received-at differ; latest receipt is not latest legitimate revision.
Source correction/suppression precedence is checked before projection and prevents replay resurrection.
Start with pending proposal is agency; it is not acceptance and invalidates whole affected compound.
Commit authorization is checked against current restriction/hold epoch even if previous epoch held no record.
If valid commit precedes later revocation preserve historical fact but cancel uncommitted dependent work; if revocation precedes commit zero effect.

Timestamp.description: Offset or Z required; local timezone is carried separately where scheduling needs it.
